pro_version.note: Pro lives in another repo; the catalog pin is the value this repo can prove, and a scheduled workflow keeps that pin honest.

lite_version.note: Same as pro_version -- pinned here, synced by sync-marketplace-pins.yml.

agents.note: Every one of them dispatched by a skill -- test_agent_wiring.py holds that line.

tests_floor.note: A floor, not an equality. Adding tests must never fail the site; dropping below the advertised number must.

sweep_raised.note: History, from the 1.7.0 entry. These three never move.
